grh_37bb2ee60c9f83fa1540.title: Echo of Madness
paragraphs: A frightened woman named Judy arrives at an isolated hotel where the staff and a man named Bruce seem to be conspiring against her, forcing her to remain while recreating disturbing sights, sounds and sensations. The apparent persecution is actually a carefully staged psychiatric treatment. Judy is Bruce's wife, and a train crash at the beginning of their honeymoon caused traumatic amnesia that erased him and the event from her memory. Re-experiencing the champagne, cold room, army blanket and passing train finally breaks through the block, restores her identity and reunites the newlyweds.
